data.narrative:
Slip Robotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $44M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comparable universe of 9 private frontier-tech firms and 1 public company in the robotics sector, including peer-stage companies Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy and applying a typical 1.9x step-up multiplier from Series B forward, yields $84M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same-stage comparables produced a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range spanning $1.6B to $2.0B. The wide divergence between methods reflects fundamental uncertainty: the stage-progression approach anchors to capital deployed, while peer multiples reflect market valuations of more mature Series B robotics firms.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $71M (floor, conservative stage method) to $2.0B (ceiling, peer high). The median implied value is $917M. Key uncertainties include whether Slip Robotics' technology maturity and market traction align with the higher-valued peer set, and whether the peer cohort—drawn from a small sample in an evolving sector—appropriately reflects risk and runway. Further diligence on unit economics, customer concentration, and IP defensibility would be necessary to narrow this range meaningfully.
